BWC::pps
Description
This command allows modification of the packets per second for the
session after a policy is created.
Syntax
BWC
::
pps
<
value
>
Examples
when
CLIENT_ACCEPTED
{
set
mycookie
[
IP
::
remote_addr
]
:
[
TCP
::
remote_port
]
BWC
::
policy
attach
gold_user
$mycookie
BWC
::
pps
77
}
